title: VTA DID-Template Delete — payload
description: Remove a DID template from a VTA by name. Omit `contextId` to remove from the global scope (super-admin gated); set it to remove a template scoped to that context (gated on the context's admin, or a super-admin). The success response echoes the deleted name for audit pipelines.

contextId.description: Scope selector. Absent: the global scope, gated on a super-administrator. Present: the context the template is scoped to, gated on that context's administrator (or a super-administrator).

name.description: Resource id — the name of the template to remove within the selected scope.

Response.title: VTA DID-Template Delete — response payload
Response.description: Confirmation that the named template was removed from the selected scope.

name.description: The deleted template's name, echoed for audit pipelines.
